headline: Sensex volatile amid CAS chaos; Nifty holds 23,300 as Adani stocks soar
why: Jefferies report sees up to 53% upside in Adani Energy and others
CAS technical issues caused a 1,000-point indicative tumble in Sensex
IT sector faced selling pressure ahead of the US Fed policy call
Tata Sons and Tata Trusts are in conflict over board governance
whatHappening: Nifty 50 ended the session above the 23,300 mark despite Sensex volatility
Adani Group stocks surged up to 12% following positive analyst outlooks
Realty stocks gained 2% while IT stocks slid over 1.5% today
Bodal Chemicals hit a 52-week high after a massive monthly rally

summary: Indian markets witnessed high volatility as technical glitches caused a temporary Sensex tumble, though Nifty managed to close above 23,300. Adani Group stocks led the gains following bullish projections from Jefferies, while the IT sector dragged the indices down ahead of the Fed meeting. Investors remain cautious due to the Rupee's decline and ongoing internal conflicts within the Tata Group leadership.
